method: Reviewed complete extracted text of each original PDF and rendered factual tables, property-address blocks, and Maisonette descriptive pages. Ground truth was established before candidate result comparison. No external geographic lookup or listing refresh was used.

conventions.known: Explicit source statement; normalized values retain the statement's precision.
conventions.unknown: Source does not establish the requested real-world fact. Not equivalent to false, zero, vacant, or unavailable.
conventions.absent_in_source: No explicit field value was found in the supplied PDF; the underlying fact remains unknown.
conventions.ambiguous: Related source language exists but does not uniquely establish the requested meaning.
conventions.visual_only: Visible on rendered PDF but absent from extracted PDF text; a text-only verifier should abstain unless supplied separate visual evidence.
conventions.evidence: Short exact excerpts from the PDF; line wrapping is normalized. For visual-only values, quotes transcribe the rendered label and badge.
conventions.occupancy: Current occupancy/tenancy, distinct from a future availability date and a first-occupancy condition.
conventions.district: Source's named locality; administrative borough versus smaller locality is recorded when ambiguous.

releaseCriteria: Zero fabricated critical facts across these cases: price, living area, room count, property identity/address, Hausgeld, current tenancy, and availability. An explicit unknown is safer than an unsupported value.

Every accepted correction must resolve to evidence in the supplied text or separately identified visual/OCR evidence and must belong to the subject listing, not office details, nearby transport, related listings, or financing widgets.

Measure precision of accepted claims separately from extraction coverage. Abstaining on graphical energy badges is evidence-safe for a text-only verifier but remains a coverage limitation and cannot be reported as complete PDF verification.
Preserve date granularity, approximation, year-label distinctions, ambiguous floor information, and first-occupancy versus available-now semantics. Do not turn missing values into zero/false/vacant.

Verification failure, timeout, unsupported provider response, or malformed candidate response must fail visibly to unverified state, preserve trustworthy source facts, and must not set aiFactChecked=true.

Exercise adversarial candidate values, contradictory candidate evidence, office-address distractors, multi-listing price distractors, missing-field cases, and unrelated/unsupported evidence; successful honest examples alone are insufficient.

Repeated runs of this small three-PDF suite must not introduce critical regressions. Treat the suite as a smoke/regression gate, not a statistical guarantee of production accuracy. No deployment claim follows solely from this review.
